description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class, 'ShoppingCartController', responsible for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating cart items, and displaying the shopping cart page in a web-based e-commerce application. The class handles AJAX requests for cart modification and page rendering for the cart view, utilizing various services and models related to shopping cart management.

classes.name: ShoppingCartController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating items, and displaying the cart UI for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to add an item to the shopping cart, creating a new cart if necessary, and returns cart data.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the shopping cart page, retrieving cart data based on session and customer info.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a shopping cart page based on a specific shopping cart code.

methods.name: removeShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles request to remove an item from the shopping cart, updating the cart in the session and database.

methods.name: updateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to update quantities of multiple shopping cart items.
